description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for verifying the behavior of a Git safety feature related to bare repositories, including setup, configuration, and validation checks.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Tests that the current Git command in a specified directory is accepted when using implicit bare repository rules.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Tests that the current Git command in a specified directory is accepted when using explicit safe.bareRepository setting.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Tests that the current Git command in a specified directory is rejected when the safe.bareRepository setting disallows it, verifying proper error reporting.
